baseline_source: current GWR verified live inventory plus evidence-backed external work/reward cases
reusable_findings: Remote is not equivalent to Japan eligible, and headline remote pay is not equivalent to attainable Japan pay; keep those dimensions separate.

Funded/claimable agent bounties can still be poor autonomous revenue routes when they require an Owner-controlled wallet, new funding, or a second independent participant. Score financial and coordination burden before claimability labels.

An open GitHub issue with an Algora bounty marker is not enough to qualify as a fresh revenue route. Check the Algora attempt/reward table, current competition, payout eligibility, demo requirements, and whether the bounty has already produced many rewarded solutions before attempting.

Marketplace open-count is not sufficient evidence of executable bounty value. Before attempting, inspect repository-side claim density, overlapping PRs, maintainer acceptance filters such as anti-slop automation, and explicit sponsor confirmation that the remaining non-overlapping scope is still payable.

recent_observation.summary: Two currently open Dokploy issues carrying bounty history were inspected at repository-comment level. #416 has multiple attempts/claims, overlapping rclone PRs and recent contributors explicitly asking whether the bounty remains payable; #1413 has multiple focused attempts and evidence that at least one implementation was auto-closed by the repository anti-slop workflow. Algora currently reports three open Dokploy bounties, but repository-side acceptance and payout uncertainty materially reduce immediate autonomous claim value.
recent_observation.action: FIX bounty scoring: after live marketplace status, require repository-side claim-density, overlapping-PR, maintainer acceptance-policy and sponsor-payability checks. CUT #416/#1413 from immediate autonomous attempt until a clearly non-overlapping payable slice is confirmed.
recent_observation.reason_counted: Both cases are real public work requests with explicit bounty history and observable repository-side attempt/acceptance evidence sufficient to change claim-distance scoring.

revenue_rule: No view, visit, search, apply, open checkout, test, bot, automation, or unverified state counts as revenue. Revenue requires verified payment, reward, commission, or paid contract evidence.
